docs.text: (Kenny) Chee Kim, Gan | 顏子鈞 I was born and raised in Malaysia until 18, before I lived in Taiwan for 8 years. Now I am staying in Los Angeles. I am a first year Ph.D student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Southern California (USC), supervised by Prof. C.-C. Jay Kuo . Previously, I served as a RA at Academia Sinica, working with Dr. Jun-Cheng chen . I earned my B.S and M.S from National Taiwan Univeristy (NTU) in Electrical Engineering, and I was fortunate to worked with Prof. Jian-Jiun Ding on Image/Video Signal Processing. google scholar: USC MCL: Research Interests My research interests span from low-level (image/video signal processing, computer vision) to high-level (computational imaging, generative AI) vision tasks. My current research project works on image codec. Hobbies I enjoy coffee, running, badminton, basketball, and watching animes/movies, solving puzzles when I am free. Experiences I gained valuable industry experiences at Novatek, MediaTek, and MobileDrive. Novatek (full-time) : Served as System-on-Chip Algorithm Engineer. I designed both hardware and software algorithm for camera SoC, mostly focusing on HDR imaging algorithms. MediaTek (internship) : I interned at the video codec standard team, had some hands-on experience on H.265 and H.266. Mobiledrive (internship) : I interned at the Advance Driver Assistance System (ADAS) team. Mostly doing software integration for Bird-Eye-View 3D object detection & tracking. Contact Email : gankenny26@gmail.com or cheekimg@usc.edu LinkedIn : LinkedIn News (2026 Aug) One paper is accepted to Siggraph Asia 2026.
